decision_rule: score >= 0.59 -> passes the gate (mlx_decision true = escalate = interrupt)
privacy: Scored texts hold a fixed STALL template, a pseudonymous session id and an elapsed-seconds count: no operator text. Session ids are replaced by neutral aliases; the logged scores are the ones recorded on the original texts. The unrelated 'respond' rows (operator rulings, transcript fragments) are excluded entirely.
sampling: No sampling: every lane-3 'laya' classify row with at <= 1792240649 is kept. Rows with an identical (text, score, prior_24h, state_chars) are collapsed; no seed needed.
